newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline softer with futures but supported.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline softer with futures but supported.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices softened in late Friday trade as futures eased, but tight high octane supply and good barge demand underpinned the market, traders said.
Barges were actively traded, with one Rotterdam refiner continuing to feature prominently as a buyer. Eurograde barges traded $2 firmer at $214.50 for refinery Rotterdam liftings.

Cargo talk was thin with arbitrage narrow and NWE demand thin. "It (the arbitrage) is not a window that's working brilliantly at the moment, but with the tight high octane situation at the moment, I expected people will be happy just to hang on to stocks," one trader said.
